title: Neo-Vintage Engraving Cover
summary: Translate an abstract idea into a visual metaphor with classical sculptural forms, fine engraved linework, and a quiet Morandi background. Adjust the format, background color, subject count, and placement.
seoTitle: Neo-Vintage Engraving Cover Prompt | Image Prompt Book
seoDescription: Create a conceptual editorial cover with black-and-white engraving, classical sculpture textures, and Morandi colors. Customize the bilingual prompt around your theme and core idea.
inputRequirement: No reference photo is required. Fill in the theme, core idea, and optional visual direction after copying the prompt.
howToUse: Adjust the highlighted format, background color, subject count, and placement options.
Copy the prompt, or open it directly in ChatGPT.
Replace the bracketed theme, core idea, and visual direction with your own information, then send. If you have no visual direction in mind, enter “use your own judgment”.
